name: Complexity.IterateFind.computesFunInTime_find
disclosure: Generalizes polyTimeComputable_find to binary numerical fuel and an arbitrary initializer. The brief requires this assembly repetition in place; all private helpers and the old theorem/final_bound are retained unchanged.

name: Turing.FinTM.decidesInTime_iff
disclosure: Required home-file reader of DecidesInTime by Iff.rfl (E3); no existing reader has this contract.

name: Complexity.mem_DTIME_iff
disclosure: Required home-file reader of DTIME by Iff.rfl (E2); no existing reader has this contract.

name: Randomized.inBPP_iff
disclosure: SR-01 approved home-file reader of InBPP by Iff.rfl; no existing reader exposed these witnesses.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.exists_countingTM
disclosure: The existential projection decider accepts some witness and does not count acceptances or give this linear-in-2^w bound. The new host instead reuses E1. H16 is unary-counter driven and would require exponential unary fuel; it is not copied.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.envelope_of_computesInTime
disclosure: Generalizes the envelope argument to a native initial configuration with only a completed computation. Clean.envelope requires a clean seam contract, absent for the composite machine. Reuses the public interval/run readers; promotion to Finite.lean is requested.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.seedFor
disclosure: Specializes the total prefix operation to a raw counting state and its unary width; reuses the existing prefix machine.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.seedFor_eq
disclosure: Required home-file equation reader for this new definition, proved by rfl; no pre-existing reader can refer to the new symbol.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.seedFor_state
disclosure: Representation-specific bridge from the raw-state seed to word; all projections use published pair readers.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.polyTimeComputable_seedFuel
disclosure: Composition of polyTimeComputable_powerOfTwo with the FP unary width; no exponential unary fuel or competing evaluator is introduced.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.polyTimeComputable_seedFor
disclosure: Reuses polyTimeComputable_takePrefixByLength, pairing, and the published binary-fuel composition for the new state.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.advance
disclosure: Counting-state-specific round using the published binary adder and P indicator. No arithmetic implementation or private loop lemma is copied.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.advance_eq
disclosure: Required home-file equation reader for this new definition, proved by rfl; no pre-existing reader can refer to the new symbol.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.polyTimeComputable_advance
disclosure: Composes published FP addition, indicator, branching, pairing, and seedFor; the input is an arbitrary raw word.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.advance_state
disclosure: Specializes add_pairEncode and the indicator reader to the new state representation.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.finished
disclosure: Terminal-rank comparison expressed using the existing binary equality test.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.finished_eq
disclosure: Required home-file equation reader for this new definition, proved by rfl; no pre-existing reader can refer to the new symbol.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.polyTimeComputable_finished
disclosure: Reuses the existing FP equality comparator and binary fuel on projected state words.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.finished_state
disclosure: Specializes the equality comparator reader to the terminal rank; no new equality algorithm.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.payload
disclosure: Strict-majority bit using existing addition and strict comparison; ties reject.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.payload_eq
disclosure: Required home-file equation reader for this new definition, proved by rfl; no pre-existing reader can refer to the new symbol.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.polyTimeComputable_payload
disclosure: Reuses FP strict comparison and addition; only the counting-state wiring is new.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.payload_state
disclosure: Representation-specific interpretation of the existing strict comparator and doubled binary count.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.polyTimeComputable_initial
disclosure: Pairs the input with two constant zero words using existing FP closure.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.length_state_le
disclosure: Applies the public binary-width bound to both counters, including rank 2^m, then the pairing-length reader. The result is specific to the new state layout.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.word
disclosure: Uses the published binary power-of-two padding. This names the fixed-width rank word; it does not define another binary encoding engine.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.word_eq
disclosure: Required home-file equation reader for this new definition, proved by rfl; no pre-existing reader can refer to the new symbol.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.length_word
disclosure: Specializes binary padding and Mathlib List.length_take to the new rank word; both published operations are reused.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.word_eq_ofFn
disclosure: Reuses bitsEquiv_apply and eq_bits_append_replicate. The new glue identifies the padded word with the inverse of the existing bijection; no bijection is re-proved.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.count
disclosure: Defines the finite prefix of accepted ranks needed by the machine. The existing majority reader counts all tuples, not rank prefixes.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.count_eq
disclosure: Required home-file equation reader for this new definition, proved by rfl; no pre-existing reader can refer to the new symbol.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.count_zero
disclosure: Specializes the empty range/filter cardinality to the new prefix count through its reader.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.count_le
disclosure: Direct application of card_le_card and card_range to the new count.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.count_succ
disclosure: Specializes card_insert_of_notMem after range_add_one/filter_insert; this is the machine-count recurrence, not a new cardinality identity.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.count_all
disclosure: Applies card_bij using the existing bitsEquiv. The language predicate is preserved by word_eq_ofFn; no separate rank bijection is constructed.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.state
disclosure: Retained-input binary rank/count representation built from the published pairing; existing clean-host stateWord is a tape layout, not this payload.

name: Complexity.SeedMajority.state_eq
disclosure: Required home-file equation reader for this new definition, proved by rfl; no pre-existing reader can refer to the new symbol.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.eff_mapCoins
disclosure: Generic verifier-level wrapper around the existing efficiency reader and P-preimage closure. No identical published coin-map wrapper was found; promotion to PolyTimeModel.lean is requested.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.exists_verifier_gap_bound
disclosure: New non-uniform bad-advice threshold argument. Reuses verifier_toNUPPT, secure_iff, negligible_iff, prgAdv/acceptance readers and uprob_fst. No advantage/expectation or uniform-projection identity is re-proved.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.exists_coin_gap_threshold
disclosure: Reuses randProb_eq_uprob and randProb_take to identify the generic gap. The new content is the root/input threshold and generator envelope.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.exists_secure_cover
disclosure: Specializes the existing secure one-bit truncation/expansion to the syntactic envelope and extracts its existing evaluator.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.short_poly
disclosure: Private specialization of lenLe_comp to |f z|+1≤N. No length-comparison machine is copied. A generic threshold-wrapper promotion beside StateLoop.lenLe_comp is requested.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.exists_seed_majority
disclosure: Reuses the majority-probability reader. Existing blockMajorityTest handles polynomially many blocks, not this full seed-space majority with piecewise PRG/true coins. No block-majority engine is copied.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.ceilRoot
disclosure: A ceiling root from the existing floor root of n-1; no root algorithm is copied.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.ceilRoot_eq
disclosure: Required home-file equation reader for this new definition, proved by rfl; no pre-existing reader can refer to the new symbol.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.ceilRoot_le_iff
disclosure: Transports nthRoot_lt_iff to the new ceiling convention, with zero handled separately.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.le_ceilRoot_pow
disclosure: Immediate least-root specialization through ceilRoot_le_iff, not a separate root construction.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.ceilRoot_zero
disclosure: Zero-case equation of the new ceiling schedule, through its own reader.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.ceilRoot_le_nat
disclosure: Least-root specialization using n≤n^d. The schedule is ceiling, unlike the floor-root provider.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.lt_ceilRoot_iff
disclosure: Strict-order dual of the new least-root reader; no new arithmetic algorithm.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.ceilRoot_le_real
disclosure: Reuses pow_nthRoot_le and the real inverse-power comparison, then adds the ceiling increment.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.polyTimeComputable_ceilRoot
disclosure: The existing evaluator returns a shifted binary floor root; this needs an exact unary ceiling root of input length. Reuses the published stateFind search and unary fixed-power/length comparisons, with no binary-root implementation copied.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.exists_root_degree
disclosure: Specializes exists_nat_gt to reciprocal exponent bounds, including ε≥1.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Randomness.Derand.seed_time_le_subexp
disclosure: Uses existing logarithm/rpow limits and the existing DTIME constant-factor transport later in the consumer. The new inequality combines the ceiling-root time and finite exceptions; no new general asymptotic or DTIME transport theorem is re-proved.
